messages:
priyanka: Hey docs team — opening a small PR to consolidate Dedicated provisioning examples. Goal: one clear migration example from legacy autoscale schema -> new scalepolicy, runnable SDK snippets for Go+Python, and a compact YAML example for tenant isolation edge cases. Also noticed a broken terraform link in the handbook (docs/provisioning/terraform/examples -> 404). Anyone available to split review chores?

emma: I can take the autoscale wording and SLA paragraph. Can we confirm the SLA change for preemptible/reserved pools? We had a follow-up about wording (99.95 vs 99.9) last quarter. :thinking_face:

ryan: I’ll do the Go SDK snippet and the terraform link fix. If you paste the broken link here I’ll update the redirect. :thumbsup:

javier: I can add the tenant isolation edge-case examples — specifically the behavior when eviction triggers and fallback routing to model-variant-b. Small note: show expected error codes and recovery path.

ashleigh: Quick QA — can someone add a small unit-testable prompt set for the migration example? I want a concrete prompt that demonstrates unchanged outputs after rollout.

priyanka: Perfect. Broken link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/provisioning/terraform/examples (404). Proposed autoscale YAML snippet for the doc (please sanity-check):
```yaml
scalepolicy:
  name: tenant-scalepolicy-v2
  kind: percent-surge
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 16
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  eviction_behavior: fallback_to_variant
  isolation_label: tenant:isolation:strict
```

priyanka: And a tiny Python SDK example to include in the migration guide (very short):
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
resp = client.update_scalepolicy(tenant_id="acme", policy_yaml=open('policy.yaml').read())
print(resp.status)
```

ryan: Go snippet (quick draft) — feel free to shorten: 
```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
resp, err := client.UpdateScalePolicy(ctx, "acme", "policy.yaml")
if err != nil { log.Fatalf("update failed: %v", err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Status)
```

emma: SLA paragraph suggestion: "Dedicated Reserved pools are covered by our 99.95% uptime SLA; preemptible/burst pools are best-effort and follow a 99.9% availability guideline. For cases where eviction is possible, docs should call out graceful fallback policies and customer-configurable isolation labels." LMK if I should PR exact wording.

javier: For the tenant isolation examples I'm going to add both a deterministic and a probabilistic failure example: one where eviction immediately triggers fallback and one where autoscale cooldown delays reclaim. That should help SRE-runbooks.

mike: CI flagged a docs-lint linkcheck on the terraform page earlier today — opened issue #823 and added a failing URL test. docs-bot: can you attach that issue to the PR when it lands?

docs-bot: Created issue #823: "handbook: provisioning/terraform/examples -> 404" and tagged docs/link-fixes.

priyanka: Thanks! Plan: I’ll open the PR with three commits: 1) autoscale YAML + migration narrative, 2) SDK snippets (Py+Go) and their runtimes notes, 3) link fix and small redirect. Assigning reviewers: emma (autoscale/SLA) & ryan (SDK + terraform link). javier will add the isolation examples in a follow-up patch. Aim to merge by EOD Friday.

emma: I’ll review Thursday morning. Quick ask: can we add one sentence about measurable cost impact when enabling prefix/KV caching with the migration? Helps PMs.

ryan: I’ll push a tiny README change to the terraform example repo after link fix so the handbook can point at a stable anchor.

ashleigh: I’ll produce the mini prompt set and post it as a gist for the PR.

priyanka: Awesome — assigning in the PR now. Tagging @emma @ryan for reviewers. Will follow up with PR link in this thread once opened. :rocket:

docs-bot: PR created: docs#1427 by priyanka — "dedicated: consolidate provisioning examples + SDK snippets". Reviewers: emma, ryan. CI: docs-lint failing on linkcheck (#823).

emma: :eyes: taking a look shortly.

ryan: On it — will fix the link and push Go snippet improvements.

javier: I’ll draft the isolation examples and ping for a separate review when ready.

priyanka: Thanks team — closing coordination here, will post PR updates.
